scope: Selected restrictions from U.S. labels for oral metformin tablets and itraconazole capsules. Product, formulation, indication and jurisdiction matter. This is not the complete label or an interaction checker.

rows.label: Contraindications
rows.text: Itraconazole hypersensitivity. Certain co-medications are also contraindicated; examples include simvastatin, lovastatin, oral midazolam and irinotecan. The full product-label interaction list must be checked.

rows.label: Indication-specific restrictions
rows.text: For fungal nail infection, the capsule label prohibits use with ventricular dysfunction or a history of heart failure, and during pregnancy or when pregnancy is planned. Other indications require the separate cardiac risk assessment below.

rows.label: Heart and liver precautions
rows.text: For other indications, ventricular dysfunction requires a benefit that clearly outweighs risk. Active liver disease, abnormal liver enzymes or prior drug-related liver toxicity strongly discourage use unless the situation is serious or life-threatening and benefit exceeds risk.

rows.label: Pregnancy, breastfeeding and medicines
rows.text: Pregnancy and breastfeeding require a separate benefit-risk assessment. An oncology pharmacist should review the complete regimen: contraindicated combinations differ from combinations needing adjustment or monitoring.

rows.label: Contraindications
rows.text: eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m²; acute or chronic metabolic acidosis, including diabetic ketoacidosis; or metformin hypersensitivity.

rows.label: Kidney function before starting
rows.text: Starting metformin at eGFR 30-45 mL/min/1.73 m² is not recommended. This is different from the formal contraindication below 30. eGFR estimates kidney filtration.

rows.label: Illness, liver disease and procedures
rows.text: The label advises avoiding use with hepatic disease. Hypoxic illness, excessive alcohol, restricted food/fluid intake around procedures, and certain contrast studies raise lactic-acidosis concerns or require a clinician-directed temporary hold.

rows.label: Medication review
rows.text: Insulin or insulin-releasing medicines increase hypoglycemia risk. Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors and drugs that reduce metformin clearance can increase acidosis or accumulation risks. These are interaction precautions, not universal contraindications.

rows.label: Product hypersensitivity
rows.text: The oral tablet is contraindicated with hypersensitivity to any component.

rows.label: Loa loa exposure
rows.text: Significant exposure in endemic areas of West or Central Africa requires pretreatment assessment for loiasis and careful follow-up because heavy infection can lead to severe or fatal encephalopathy.

rows.label: Pregnancy and breastfeeding
rows.text: The label advises against use in pregnancy because safety has not been established. Breastfeeding requires weighing the maternal risk of delayed treatment against possible newborn risk.

rows.label: Children below 15 kg
rows.text: Safety and effectiveness have not been established in children weighing less than 15 kg.

rows.label: Warfarin
rows.text: Rare reports describe increased INR with concurrent warfarin. This is an interaction precaution, not the formal hypersensitivity contraindication.

rows.label: Label restrictions and eligibility review
rows.text: The cited OTC label advises against use with aspirin allergy or a previous allergic reaction to another pain reliever or fever reducer.

rows.label: Label restrictions and eligibility review
rows.text: Acute liver failure, decompensated cirrhosis and hypersensitivity to the product are contraindications.

rows.label: Label restrictions and eligibility review
rows.text: Contraindications include celecoxib or sulfonamide hypersensitivity, aspirin/NSAID allergic reactions, and use around coronary bypass surgery.

rows.label: Label restrictions and eligibility review
rows.text: Concurrent or recent MAO inhibitors and the acute recovery period after myocardial infarction are contraindications.

rows.label: Label restrictions and eligibility review
rows.text: Severe myocardial disease or coronary occlusion, psychosis, and hypersensitivity are contraindications. Alcohol-containing preparations and metronidazole must be avoided.

rows.label: Label restrictions and eligibility review
rows.text: Tetracycline hypersensitivity is a contraindication.

rows.label: Label restrictions and eligibility review
rows.text: Known fluconazole hypersensitivity is a contraindication; certain QT-prolonging combinations, including pimozide and quinidine, are also contraindicated.
